title: HealthCLBench:Evaluating Context Learning in Health Conversations through Controlled Case Clusters
abstract: arXiv:2611.22362v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Complex health conversations require answers grounded in individual information and currently valid evidence. We evaluate health context learning: acquiring, integrating, and applying relevant context during inference with fixed model parameters to answer health questions and respond appropriately to changes in facts, evidence, or task goals. To our knowledge, Chinese-language medical benchmarks have yet to systematically combine explicit contextual difficulties, controlled case variations, and member-specific medical criteria for open-ended answers. We introduce HealthCLBench, comprising 328 controlled clusters, 1,103 cases, and 4,931 rubric criteria across medical consultation and everyday health management. Members share backgrounds while evidence, patient states, or task goals change; each has its own medical scoring requirements. A 70-person medical team annotates and reviews the simulated cases and their rubrics. Human review of 70

translated_title: HealthCLBench：通过受控病例集群评估健康对话中的上下文学习
translated_abstract: 复杂的健康对话需要答案既立足于个人信息，又基于当前有效的证据。我们评估健康上下文学习（health context learning）：在模型参数固定的情况下，在推理过程中获取、整合和应用相关上下文，以回答健康问题，并对事实、证据或任务目标的变化做出恰当回应。据我们所知，中文医学基准尚未系统地结合明确的上下文难点、受控的病例变体以及针对开放式答案的个体化医学评判标准。我们提出了HealthCLBench，涵盖医疗咨询和日常健康管理两大领域，包含328个受控集群、1,103个病例和4,931条评分标准。集群内各成员共享背景信息，而证据、患者状态或任务目标则发生变化；每个病例都有其特定的医学评分要求。由70人组成的医疗团队对模拟病例及其评分标准进行标注与审核。人工审核了70（原文摘要在此处截断，后续内容缺失）
tldr: 该论文提出了中文健康对话基准HealthCLBench，通过328个受控病例集群和4,931条评分标准，系统评估大模型在参数固定情况下获取、整合并应用上下文以应对事实、证据和任务目标变化的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HealthCLBench, a Chinese health conversation benchmark with 328 controlled case clusters and 4,931 rubric criteria to systematically evaluate how models acquire, integrate, and apply context under fixed parameters when responding to changes in facts, evidence, and task goals.
